SEBI orders refund to affected investors

June 15, 2024

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has ordered ABC Company to refund ₹50 crore to affected investors who subscribed to the IPO between January 2023 and March 2023.

All eligible investors may submit a claim form available at claim form (PDF).

The deadline for submitting claims is December 31, 2024.

Investors will need to provide proof of investment including transaction receipts and bank statements.
